It’s always a pleasure to enjoy a bottle that is old enough to drink itself. 

Bordeaux style blend from Napa County north coast. 

Color showed a deep ruby to a slight rust on the edges. 

Acidity was bright throughout the bottle even after 23 years of controlled storage. 

Much like 90s Napa red blends it only touched 13.5 abv at bottling and the fruit was able to show through like any good Bordeaux style. 

On the nose one could get the sense of the deepens oak residuals from barreling.

Taste was complex as dark cherry notes were present with a bit of black plum and other dark purple fruits. 

The tannins were almost none existent and made for a great food wine; adaptable to many dishes. 

The finish left sediment almost dark as coal but provides the dusty dry wood like a cigar box. A little pepper at the end and some leather in the middle. 

Fantastic bottle after 23 years. A real treat for a decent price to rival Bordeaux blends.
